items.summary: New Mexico's first week of early voting (Oct 6-8, via NM Secretary of State): 21,022 ballots cast statewide, with Democrats outvoting Republicans more than 2-to-1 (12,526 Dem vs 5,504 Rep; 2,868 declined-to-state; 669 Dem vs 74 Rep absentee). In Doña Ana County, 3,532 ballots by party registration (2,169 Dem, 843 Rep) — county totals independently carried by Organ Mountain News citing the same SoS report. Expanded early voting opens Oct 17-31. Context: Democrats are banking the early vote in a state where Haaland leads the governor's race 49-42 in the latest ABQ Journal poll.
items.title: New Mexico first-week early voting: 21,022 ballots, Democrats cast more than double Republicans
